name: Arcane Odyssey 🌊
desc:
**This game has thousands of items and textures so 6 GB+ RAM is recommended**
**Keyboard + Mouse Required to Play**
** Dragon Update Patch Notes: https://devforum.roblox.com/t/ao/4615115 **

Embark on an epic journey through the War Seas, taking part in the conflicts of kingdoms and organizations striving for power. Many will die, but only the strong survive in this harsh, magic-polluted world. 

Conflicts are high as the many kingdoms wage war over possession of Curses, powerful artifacts which grant the user immortality and great power. After defeating great rulers and psychopaths for what you believe is the greater good, you leave yourself questioning what your true purpose in this world is.

Fight against other players, or team up with them and rule the seas as a clan, capturing islands, building castles, and becoming more infamous. Since you were born a mage, you have the option of mastering your magic, or dropping it entirely in favor of fighting styles, weapon mastery, and more.

scripts.title: Auto Item Farm
scripts.features:
--> Released: AO Item Farm has been released. Although, be careful using it, because it's quite risky (it's around 90% risk-free). Even though I managed to get around 400 items using it without getting banned, by mistake I executed the script multiple times which got me to being banned. This goes to show that you need to be extra careful. I recommend using it on an alt, and then trade the wanted items to your main.

--> Features:
  --> Slowly: The script will have pretty high delay in collecting items, but despite looking bad, it still collects a pretty high amount over time.
  --> Blanks: The script sometimes will intentionally not collect the item in order to decrease the risk.
  --> QoL: Instead of the game itself, the screen will be covered with the HsB UI, which will also tell you how much items you've collected (Beware that the number displayed may not be 100% accurate, will be fixed in next updates)
  --> Redirect: If the script will throw an error, you will be informed about it, and also with a simple instruction to what to do next.

scripts.title: Auto Fishing
scripts.features:
--> Features:
  --> Auto-Fishing: The script will automatically fish for you *IF YOU HAVE THE WOODEN ROD*. (As stated above, if people are interested I will update it to diversity)
  --> Auto-Eating: While fishing, if your hunger drops below 99, the player will quickly munch on one of these items in your inventory: Red Apple, Coconut, Grapes, White mushroom, Brown mushroom.
  --> Hidden: To lower the risk, you're hidden from other players.
  --> Don't-Disturb: Your player is constantly locked in a position, making it difficult for the user to accidentally stop the farm.
--> Requirements:
  --> As mentioned above, those are the only allowed items to be ate for now. (It's really more of a soft-requirement, since you can still fish without them, but you'll die of starvation in some time)
  --> Shift-locking may tamper with the auto farm, so if you alt tabbed from the game, it's possible your farm may have stopped (can be fixed in future updates)
  --> Wooden Rod.
  --> Recommended to be on server under 200 ping, as this ping 100% will break the farm, and not even start (can be fixed in future updates easily)
